name: dsh-raindrop-plugin
description: DSH web GUI plugin by raindrop: calendar dates in the sidebar, a date-view panel (first/last date, date sorting, range filtering), a searchable workspace picker, a project label above each sidebar Session title, a per-session git branch badge that restores the session's branch when it is opened again, a top alert when the selected model spends the user's own DeepSeek quota, and a sidebar footer with the running and latest DSH versions.
author: raindrop

scripts.prepublishOnly: node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/client.js && node --check lib/git.js
